model_annotation: This bar chart, labeled (a) “各语体中文配动词的一级语义域分布” and (b) “各语体中承受动词的一级语义域分布,” presents two separate bar charts comparing the distribution of first-level semantic domains for two types of Chinese verbs—“中配动词” (middle voice verbs) and “承受动词” (passive voice verbs)—across four different discourse styles: “新闻” (news), “传统文学” (traditional literature), “网络小说” (online novels), and “微博” (Weibo). Both charts share a vertical y-axis labeled “频次” (frequency) with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7,000, with tick marks at intervals of 1,000. The horizontal x-axis lists the four discourse styles in the order: news, traditional literature, online novels, and Weibo. Each bar is segmented into colored parts representing different semantic domains, with a legend in chart (a) listing domains such as “人际” (interpersonal), “社会” (social), “自然” (natural), etc., each assigned a unique color. In chart (a), the “网络小说” (online novels) bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 6,700 frequency, followed by “微博” (~6,400), “新闻” (~5,800), and “传统文学” (~5,000). The “新闻” bar has a dominant blue segment labeled “人际” (interpersonal) at 40%, while the “微博” bar shows a dominant blue segment labeled “人际” (interpersonal) at 45%. In chart (b), the bars are significantly shorter overall, with “微博” reaching approximately 4,500 frequency, followed by “网络小说” (~3,000), “新闻” (~2,000), and “传统文学” (~1,000). The “微博” bar also has a dominant blue segment labeled “人际” (interpersonal) at 50%, while “新闻” has a dominant blue segment labeled “人际” (interpersonal) at 40%. Both charts display the bars without explicit sorting or emphasis beyond their height and color segmentation.
